summary: Full backend + frontend + e2e review of AYANA. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_live_review.py (49 new live tests against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) covering auth (register/login/me/refresh/logout+revocation/rate-limit 429), security (401/403 on protected + admin routes, CORS), onboarding (profile/OTP/consent/parents/schedules/activation), replies/simulate mapping (1/2/3/Telugu + num_media voice flag + distress -> emergency event -> admin/emergencies), emergency contacts + event status update, moments image upload -> signed URL -> object-storage streaming, care circle invite + public token preview, payments gating (skipped:true, 404 on unknown session), reports, admin endpoints. Total pytest 169/169 passing after one real backend bug was fixed. Frontend: drove signup -> onboarding (OTP verify -> plan -> parent + check-ins -> activate) -> all 7 dashboard tabs -> moment image upload -> care-circle invite -> /invite/:token claim page with Playwright. Found ONE CRITICAL app-wide blocker: CSRF protection is unimplementable from the browser, so every CSRF-protected mutating endpoint returns 403 for real users.

critical.issue: CSRF is unsatisfiable from the browser -> hard 403 'CSRF token missing'. auth.py defines generate_csrf_token()/set_csrf_cookie() but NEITHER IS EVER CALLED anywhere in the codebase, so no csrf_token cookie is ever issued. frontend/src/lib/api.js uses cookie-only auth (the Authorization Bearer request interceptor is COMMENTED OUT, lines 16-21) and never sends X-CSRF-Token. validate_csrf_token() only bypasses when an 'Authorization: Bearer ' header is present. Net effect: pytest passes (it uses Bearer) but the real UI is broken. Reproduced: POST /api/consent with cookies only -> 403; POST /api/circle/invite from the browser -> 403. This BLOCKS ONBOARDING COMPLETELY (step 0 -> POST /consent -> 403, wizard never reaches step 1) so no new user can activate.

minor.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: returned raw mongo doc containing an ObjectId parent_id -> FastAPI jsonable_encoder crash -> HTTP 500 ("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"). Changed to return serialize(report) (server.py:1350). Verify: the GET /api/reports/monthly sibling already used serialize().

In simulated mode the 6-digit code is never surfaced anywhere — not in the API response, not in the logs — and it is bcrypt-hashed in phone_otps. Since /onboarding step0-next is hard-gated on phoneVerified, onboarding is untestable/unusable without direct DB access. Suggest returning the code (or logging it) only when WHATSAPP_ENABLED=false, or exposing a dev_code in /api/config-gated responses.
Garbage/non-JWT token returns 400 (InvalidTokenError) rather than 404. Acceptable but inconsistent with the documented expectation; frontend InviteClaim handles it fine.

minor.endpoint: CORS (infra note, not an app bug)
minor.issue: The FastAPI CORSMiddleware correctly returns the explicit origin + allow-credentials (verified on the pod). The k8s/Cloudflare ingress rewrites Access-Control-Allow-Origin to '*' on preflight for the public URL and drops allow-credentials on OPTIONS. Simple (non-preflight) requests do carry the explicit origin. No app change needed.

ui_bugs.issue: BLOCKER: after OTP verification + consent, clicking Continue calls PUT /profile/child (200) then POST /consent (403 CSRF) -> toast error, wizard stays on step 0 forever. Reproduced on a fresh signup. Same root cause as the backend CRITICAL item.

ui_bugs.component: Dashboard CareCircle / Plan / Check-ins / Reports / Account
ui_bugs.issue: All write actions 403 in the real browser: invite-send (POST /circle/invite), Change plan (POST /payment/checkout), schedule create/update/delete, recovery start/end, Say hi, Send test, Generate monthly report, parent Verify number (parent OTP verify). Read-only tabs render fine.

The 401 refresh path reads localStorage 'ayana_refresh_token', but nothing ever writes it (the Bearer request interceptor is commented out). So silent refresh always short-circuits to reject; observed repeated 401 /api/auth/refresh on every page load. Users will be hard-logged-out when the access cookie expires instead of being refreshed. The cookie-based POST /api/auth/refresh does work (verified in pytest) — the interceptor just never uses it.
The 'Confirm parent' button is NOT disabled while the required parent-consent checkbox is unchecked; clicking it only fires a toast. The parent consent checkbox has no data-testid.

The '🎉 Care Circle activated' toast is not observable — activate() navigates to /dashboard immediately, so the toast unmounts before it can be read. Activation itself succeeded (dashboard shows Care circle = Active).
The Say-hi / edit / delete parent icon buttons and 'Add parent' have no data-testid (icon-only buttons, no aria-label either) — not automatable and not screen-reader friendly.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot complete in a real browser due to the CSRF 403 on POST /consent. Verified the whole wizard DOES work end-to-end when an Authorization: Bearer header is injected via Playwright route interception (consent 200 -> plan raksha -> parent + 3 check-ins saved -> activate -> dashboard 'Care circle Active'), which isolates CSRF as the sole cause.

URL -> POST /api/moments 200 (no CSRF dep) -> the thumbnail streams and renders in 'Recently sent'. Bad signature on a signed URL is correctly rejected. Non-image upload correctly rejected.

Invite creation is 403 in the browser (CSRF); when created via API the /invite/:token page renders correctly (inviter name, benefits, expiry) and correctly shows the 'Wrong account' guard when the logged-in email differs from the invited email.

Onboarding step 2 uses native <input type="time"> and native <select> for relationship/language/timezone (browser default pickers) while the check-in category uses a shadcn Select — inconsistent control language.
Onboarding parent form is very long (4 sections) with no sticky save action; the save button is far below the fold.

action_items: CRITICAL — Fix CSRF so the browser can actually mutate state. Pick ONE: (a) call generate_csrf_token()+set_csrf_cookie() on /auth/register, /auth/login and /auth/refresh (non-HttpOnly csrf cookie) AND add an axios request interceptor in frontend/src/lib/api.js that copies document.cookie csrf_token into the X-CSRF-Token header; or (b) re-enable the commented-out Bearer request interceptor in api.js (lines 16-21) and store access_token/refresh_token on login/register/refresh. Option (a) is the secure one given HttpOnly cookies.

HIGH — Fix the api.js 401 refresh interceptor: it depends on localStorage 'ayana_refresh_token' which is never written; use the cookie-based POST /api/auth/refresh (withCredentials) instead. Currently every 401 hard-fails and the app fires 401 /api/auth/refresh on every load.
MEDIUM — Surface the OTP code when WHATSAPP_ENABLED=false (response field or a log line) so onboarding is usable/testable in the simulated environment; otherwise no one can get past step 0.
MEDIUM — Disable 'Confirm parent' until the parent-consent checkbox is ticked; add data-testid to that checkbox.
MEDIUM — Add data-testid (and aria-label) to Dashboard parent card icon buttons (say-hi / edit / delete) and 'Add parent'.
LOW — Show the activation success toast before navigating to /dashboard (or pass it via router state and toast on the dashboard).
LOW — Return 404 (not 400) for a structurally invalid /api/circle/invite/{token}, for consistency.
VERIFY — Re-run /api/reports/monthly/generate after my serialize() fix (was HTTP 500).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: generate_csrf_token() and set_csrf_cookie() are dead code — never referenced. Any security control that is declared but never wired is worse than none: it produced a silent, total write-path outage that the 120-test pytest suite could not see because every test authenticates with a Bearer header. Add at least one cookie-auth (no Authorization header) integration test per CSRF-protected route.

frontend/src/lib/api.js: leaving the Bearer interceptor commented out (lines 16-21) while the response interceptor still depends on localStorage tokens leaves the auth layer in an inconsistent half-migrated state. Pick one auth transport and delete the other path.
server.py is 2094 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Split into routers (auth, parents, schedules, circle, moments, replies/webhook, admin).

server.py: CSRF is applied inconsistently — POST /moments, POST /parents, PUT /profile/child, POST /auth/otp/verify have NO CSRF dependency while POST /consent and POST /parents/{id}/otp/verify do. Whatever the fix, make the policy uniform across all mutating routes.
monthly_report.generate_monthly_report() returns a raw mongo document with ObjectId fields; any caller that returns it directly 500s. Serialize inside the generator, not at each call site.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Root cause of the app-wide write failure is CSRF (see critical item). To test the UI BEFORE it is fixed, inject a Bearer header in Playwright: token = (await (await page.request.post(BASE+'/api/auth/login', data={...})).json())['access_token']; then page.route('**/api/**', lambda add authorization header). To drive OTP in the UI, run `python /app/backend/tests/otp_test_watcher.py 600 &` first — it rewrites any new phone_otps hash so the code is 123456 (WHATSAPP_ENABLED=false never reveals the real code). Backend regression suite: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -p no:randomly -q` (169 tests; use -n0 to disable xdist when debugging session fixtures). AFTER the CSRF fix, re-run WITHOUT the Bearer injection and confirm: onboarding step0 Continue, plan select, activation toast, circle invite-send, schedule CRUD, recovery start/end, say-hi, send-test, generate monthly report, parent Verify number. Not yet tested: Stripe live path (PAYMENTS_ENABLED=false), real WhatsApp webhook ingestion, Sarvam ML distress (no credits -> keyword fallback), scheduler cron firing, /admin UI pages, mobile/tablet viewports.
rca_of_the_issue: validate_csrf_token() (auth.py:230) demands a csrf_token cookie AND a matching X-CSRF-Token header for every mutating request, bypassing only when an 'Authorization: Bearer ' header is present. The helpers that would issue that cookie (generate_csrf_token / set_csrf_cookie, auth.py:166/171) are never called from anywhere — grep shows zero call sites. Meanwhile frontend/src/lib/api.js deliberately went cookie-only (Bearer request interceptor commented out) and never sends X-CSRF-Token. Therefore every browser request to a CSRF-guarded route fails closed with 403 'CSRF token missing'. The pre-existing 120-test pytest suite masked this entirely because it authenticates with Bearer tokens, hitting the bypass branch. Repro: curl -c j -X POST /api/auth/login -d '{...}' ; curl -b j -X POST /api/consent -d '{"consent_type":"child","agreed":true,"text":"x"}' -> 403. Mitigation: issue a readable csrf_token cookie on login/register/refresh and mirror it into the X-CSRF-Token header from an axios request interceptor (double-submit cookie), then add cookie-auth integration tests for every mutating route.
